name: token-police
description: Deterministic agent usage accounting and bounded cost controls. No LLM calls for monitoring.

interface.longDescription: Measure agent usage, inspect avoidable waste, and apply bounded local controls. Routine collection and hooks make zero model calls. Costs remain unknown until supplied or priced from explicit receipts. Requires Python 3.10+ and a supported local execution environment; hosted tools and unrelated model requests are outside hook coverage. Observe mode is the default.
capabilities: Apply bounded output and read controls
defaultPrompt: Inspect Token Police status and the highest priority finding.
Compare cost per accepted task for my pilot.
Check whether my usage evidence is complete.
